contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C ALLECTVS PF AVG ; R/ FIDES MILITVM

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of Allectus (293-296) (Reece Period 14), C mint issue, S P//C. Obverse description: radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C ALLECTVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Fides standing left holding two standards. Reverse inscription: FIDES MILITVM. RIC V, pt 2, p. 565, no. 69. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 23.2mm, Weight: 3.43gms, die axis: 6. This coin is included in Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
